feat(security): Implement security and reliability improvements

This commit implements critical security improvements and reliability enhancements
identified from the audit of PR #61 (Authentication) and PR #62 (API Layer).

Key Changes:
- Add CSRF protection with double-submit cookie pattern
- Implement Redis-based rate limiting
- Configure security headers (HSTS, CSP, etc.)
- Add request timeout and circuit breakers
- Enhance type safety with Zod validation

Security Improvements:
- CSRF token validation and refresh
- Rate limiting with Redis
- Comprehensive security headers
- Request validation

Reliability Enhancements:
- Request timeout handling
- Circuit breaker pattern
- Error boundary improvements
- Type safety enhancements

Dependencies Added:
- rate-limiter-flexible
- helmet
- ioredis
- zod
- @chronobase/circuit-breaker

Testing:
- Added unit tests for security measures
- Added integration tests for API client
- Added E2E tests for critical flows

Documentation:
- Added security configuration guide
- Updated API documentation
- Added error handling documentation

Related Issues:
- Resolves #61 audit findings
- Resolves #62 audit findings
- Addresses security recommendations
